summary: GtinIndex.ensureFile relies on File.renameTo to replace a corrupted installed sidecar. On some Android filesystems, renameTo may fail when destination exists, causing lookup to throw and leaving the corrupted file.
claim: If sidecar becomes corrupted and rename fails, barcode lookup is unavailable until next attempt (which may also fail), impacting feature availability.

evidence.source: Code: 'check(temporary.renameTo(file)) { "Could not install barcode index" }'. Android documentation notes renameTo may fail on some filesystems; no fallback delete+rename or Files.move with REPLACE_EXISTING.

suggested_remediation: Use atomic replace supported by java.nio.file.Files.move with REPLACE_EXISTING/ATOMIC_MOVE, or delete destination before rename with proper error handling.
suggested_validation: Simulate corrupted installed sidecar and verify self-repair succeeds on all supported Android API levels/filesystems.
